theme: A clear day whose real work is what's owed, not what's booked.

needsAttention.title: December break — decide and book
needsAttention.detail: The shortlist was due Sept 30 and the Oct 15 book-by for six people over three holiday weeks is the thinnest inventory of the year. With passports now landing in November, a domestic shortlist is the safe default.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out; a refundable booking held now costs nothing and closes the risk.
